claim: Custom domain names for private APIs don't need to be unique across multiple accounts: you can create the same private custom domain name in different accounts, as long as your ACM certificate covers the domain name.

evidence.quote: Custom domain names for private APIs don’t need to be unique across multiple accounts. You can create `example.private.com` in account 111122223333 and in account 555555555555, as long as your ACM certificate covers the domain name.
